independent_review_findings_addressed: Real protocol stdin/stdout now uses nonblocking file-descriptor I/O with bounded final lock acquisition and delivery.
One EpisodeDeadline starts immediately after task receipt and covers setup, model, executor, cancellation, and final delivery.
The runner enforces executor deadlines and propagates cancellation after recording uncertain attempts.
Structured observation secrets are registered for redaction in later prompts/code/errors; inline password/token fields and dependency stderr are redacted.
Persistent no-evidence successful finals become controlled unsuccessful responses.
Malformed inner public input and setup failures enter bounded controlled finalization with a fixed fallback.
Cumulative stdout has a final reserve; process-wide stderr has a bounded redacting proxy.
SDK-level retries are disabled so the application owns retry counts and deadlines.
History trimming respects its exact configured size and preserves latest evidence.
Protocol version/type fields are required and inner AppWorld JSON rejects nonfinite numbers.
Final self-assessment and delivery outcomes are logged; malformed public text output is retained within privacy limits.
CI covers Python 3.11-3.13, Pydantic AI 2.66/2.74, built-wheel episodes, and both entry points.
